samples.question: Which abstract symbol appears after the declared cumulative raster transform? Find the single navy-framed square with a red corner marker. Its interior is an 8-by-8 raster of two visible tones; treat the darker tone as 1 and the lighter tone as 0. Apply the declared upper-left integral XOR: for each cell, replace it with the XOR of every original cell in the rectangle from the marked top-left cell through that cell. Read the resulting 8-by-8 bitmap. Compare it with A = #.#.#.#./...#####/#.#.#.#./.#.#.#.#/#.#.#.#./.#.#.#.#/#.#.#.#./.#.#.#.. or B = #..##.#./..####../.######./########/#..##.#./...##.../...##.../...##... using Hamming distance; ties or a gap below 4 are quarantined. Answer A or B. Ignore the remote colored marks.
